failure_story: Capital is committed near $26 on the strength of a $36.3m pro forma Cash Available for Distribution figure read as a durable income stream. It is not one. CAFD is struck before depletion: pro forma DD&A of $36.451m is essentially equal to pro forma CAFD of $36.317m, and pro forma FY2025 net income is a $32.330m loss. The reserve report behind it books 206,473 MMcfe against 24,548 MMcfe of pro forma annual production - an 8.4-year total proved life and a 7.27-year producing life. Distributions are therefore mostly return of capital on a wasting asset. Gas prices soften back toward the $2.13/MMBtu deck that produced the prior year's $72m PV-10 rather than the $3.387 deck behind today's $293.690m. The board, having never declared a dividend as a public company, sets an initial payout below what the CAFD headline implied, or cuts it within two years as PDP rolls over. The equity re-rates from roughly 2.7x PV-10 toward asset value. Holders discover late that the FY2025 restatement concluded seven weeks before the IPO and the identified material weaknesses in internal control were not cosmetic: the misstatements were in management-fee recording and acquisition cash classification, the two lines that the Internalization and the acquisition-driven growth story both run through. The earnout, up to 1,250,000 additional OpCo units against Adjusted EBITDA targets the company itself defines and reports, is met on reported numbers while per-share value falls.
earliest_warnings: The first 10-Q as a public company reports net production below the 64,270 Mcfe/d run-rate of Q1 2026 without an offsetting acquisition, confirming the producing decline is real and unmitigated.
An initial declared dividend materially below the pro forma CAFD run-rate of roughly $1.30 per Class A share, or a stated policy of retaining CAFD for acquisitions instead of distributing it.
Any restatement, late filing, or repeat material-weakness disclosure in the first 10-Q or 10-K, given the April 22, 2026 conclusion that FY2025 statements could not be relied upon.
Adjusted EBITDA outperformance concentrated in periods that determine the earnout, with the gain traceable to acquisition timing or fee add-backs rather than volumes.
The FY2026 reserve report showing negative revisions to the 206,473 MMcfe proved book, or PV-10 falling toward the prior-year $72m level on a lower SEC price deck.
forensic_checks: Reconcile CAFD to net cash provided by operating activities line by line. Pro forma FY2025 operating cash flow is $9.533m against $36.317m of CAFD, and pro forma Q1 2026 operating cash flow is negative $10.714m against $9.959m of CAFD. Confirm which add-backs are genuinely non-recurring rather than recharacterised operating costs.

Test the management-fee add-back of $21.795m. It comprises $6.2m Base Management Fees, $3.7m Dividend Incentive Fees and $13.6m Liquidity Incentive Fees less $1.7m of estimated internal compensation. The Liquidity Incentive Fee is IPO-triggered and would never recur; confirm the run-rate saving is the roughly $8.2m of recurring fees replaced by internal cost, not the headline $21.8m.
Compare depletion to CAFD every period. If DD&A continues to approximate CAFD, the distribution is return of capital and the payout ratio on economic earnings exceeds 100%.

Recompute PV-10 sensitivity to the SEC price deck. The FY2024 column shows $72.153m of PV-10 on 87,213 MMcfe at $2.13/MMBtu Henry Hub against $293.690m on 206,473 MMcfe at $3.387; isolate how much of the year-over-year gain is price rather than the PHX and TRR acquisitions.

Trace the Up-C ownership arithmetic. The prospectus states IPO purchasers hold 24.8% of OpCo indirectly, while 33.5% of the Company times the Company's 86.0% OpCo interest is 28.8%. Those do not tie; establish which is right before relying on any per-share figure.
Read the restatement disclosure and the remediation plan in full, and confirm whether the auditor has opined on internal control over financial reporting or is exempt as a newly public company.

short_source_coverage.detail: The frozen adversarial pass records no Tier-1 forensic short in short_scan_2026-05-28.md and no local short_reports/ directory, and the third-party cross-check indexes no sources at all. Short coverage on a company that IPO'd 2026-06-10 is expected to be thin, but it means no independent adversarial party has examined this name and the absence of a short thesis carries no information.

unresolved_items: No 10-Q or 10-K has been filed since the 2026-06-10 IPO, so every operating figure in the packet is pro forma and unaudited as presented, and sec_companyfacts.json carries only S-1 fee-table concepts.
No dividend policy has been declared, so the distribution that the entire owner-cash component values is uncommitted.

Unbooked mineral acreage beyond the proved book is not quantified anywhere in the packet, yet it is the most plausible explanation for the gap between the contract's $5.71 base and the $26.16 market price.
The remediation status of the identified material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting is not established.
The 24.8% versus 28.8% OpCo ownership discrepancy in the prospectus is flagged in the contract partition note and remains unreconciled.
The frozen adversarial review is a mechanical batch pass that performed no filing reconciliation and no disclosure scan, so the packet contains no genuine independent challenge.
